body: As you watch the frustrated expression on your co-op partner’s face, a protective warmth envelops you. They need your strength right now, but the fear of getting hurt deepens inside. The urge to shield them becomes overwhelming, yet there’s also an instinctual pull towards maintaining personal boundaries. In that moment, you take a step back, feeling both connected and isolated. "Stay beside them and keep them steady," you whisper softly to yourself as you inch closer, ready to offer support without compromising too much. "Put real distance between myself and it," you resolve, letting go of any further attempt to intervene in their disagreement until they’re ready to lean into help again.
